messages:
Nina Torres: dropped a GIF and a new flow for Create Token modal — single-step with scope checklist and an optional expiration selector. gif: https://imgur.com/createflow
Diego Alvarez: flow looks clean. question: if user picks expiration, do we auto-enforce rotation reminders?
Hannah Li: prefer not to auto-enforce. instead surface a scheduled reminder card in the tokens list and let org policies override.
Jordan (UX): UX nit: expiration selector should default to 'never' with a subtle hint 'recommended for public apps'. avoids surprising users. also move 'Show secret once' copy next to the reveal toggle.
Nina Torres: good. also adding a small inline warning when scopes include "admin:keys": "This scope allows revocation and rotation across the org. Requires admin approval." make it a yellow banner under the scope list.
Diego Alvarez: security note: if user creates a token with org-wide scope, we should require MFA or an approval step. Ops: what are tradeoffs?
infra-bot: (automated) org-policy: require_approval=true for scope=admin:keys for orgs with >50 seats. See policy id: pol-7821
Hannah Li: okay surface that as a required checkbox 'Request admin approval' (disabled state shows reason). copy: 'Your request will be reviewed by org admins.'
Jordan (UX): accessibility: the modal must trap focus; the expiration dropdown must be keyboard reachable and announce the selected value. aria-describedby for the warning banner.
Nina Torres: reveal behavior: show secret only on creation screen with a one-click copy and 'Download .txt' link. warn: "This secret will not be shown again."
Diego Alvarez: operational concern: users still paste into terminal and lose visibility. add a small quick link in the token row to 'Show last created (copy-only) for 60s' gated by permission. logs this event.
Hannah Li: copy suggestions: avoid 'token' vs 'key' inconsistencies. I'd recommend 'API token' everywhere in product and 'credential' in legal docs. Nina, can you sync with content?
Nina Torres: yes I'll sync. Jordan: microcopy for revoke confirmation? proposed: 'Revoke token "name"? This action cannot be undone. You can create a replacement token.' buttons: Revoke (danger) + Cancel + 'Revoke + Notify team' checkbox.
Jordan (UX): prefer 'soft confirm' for org tokens: show revoke modal with 'Revoke' and an additional undo toast for personal tokens only. For org tokens require confirmation + audit log.
Diego Alvarez: keyboard/accessibility for list: add a visible focus ring for each row, Enter to open details, k/j to move up/down (vim-like) as an optional shortcut. Add aria-roledescription="token row" for screen readers.
infra-bot: (automated) audit-log will capture revoke action with user and IP.
Hannah Li: empty-state copy for teams with no tokens: 'No API tokens yet — Create a token to get started.' CTA primary: 'Create token' secondary: 'Token best practices' (link). keep visual contrast high.
Nina Torres: next steps: Jordan to update Figma with warning banners + modals, Diego to write security acceptance criteria for approvals and audit events, Hannah to draft copy and empty-state microcopy. I'll open a short PR for the modal and tag infra for policy enforcement. :sparkles:
